verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-driven SaaS platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents scoped API keys, per-credential permissions, or agent-specific credentials. The authentication evidence covers only webhook signing (shared secret) and SAML SSO/SCIM for user provisioning, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
